name: akc-cycle
description: Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC) skill layer — the cycle-phase skills (Research / Extract / Curate / Promote / Measure / Maintain) plus companion skills grounded in AKC concepts (generation audit, scaffold dissolution, ADRs with review-when, review-to-lint, LLM-as-judge, author-calibrated eval, skill creation with a draft gate, machine verification gates, measurement discipline). The always-loaded rules-file floor (rules/common/akc-cycle.md) is not part of the plugin; copy it into your rules directory separately.
